title: check_level.py report
description: One repo's results against the requirements in levels.toml. A new field is not a breaking change; a breaking change bumps schema_version.

level.description: The level from .copier-answers.yml or --level; null when the repo declares none, and then every requirement is not_applicable.

requirements.description: One item per requirement in levels.toml, in its order.

since.description: The date the requirement starts to count; before it, a reader may show the result without counting it.

status.description: not_applicable: above the repo's level, for traits it lacks, or its condition does not hold. unchecked: a person judges it, or the facts are not in the files.

evidence.description: For met, the paths that meet it; otherwise the reason, in one line.
